items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1957-03-26
items.q: No, no, that's Joe Moranison. Looks like Joe Moranison.

ctx.x: It looks like they got a bottle of muscatel. That Harry Shields?

Yeah. No, no, she ain't there. No, no, that's Joe Moranison. Looks like Joe Moranison. Looks like Joe Moranison. I can't see so well. I know Head Brunus was in that bunch, I believe, the day they came in.
